body: A speech recognition model for multilingual transcription and translation into English.
plain_description: **Turn audio into written text and translate speech across languages.** Transcribe audio files from the command line or Python, and identify the language being spoken.
technical_description: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model trained on diverse audio. It supports multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, language identification, and voice activity detection. Install with pip and use from the command line or Python; it depends on ffmpeg and uses PyTorch. Available model sizes have different memory and speed requirements.
title: Whisper
